verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents an official Snowflake CLI for creating, managing, updating, and viewing apps across Streamlit, Native Apps, Snowpark Container Services, and Snowpark. The probe confirms the docs page, and the docs cover migration from the older SnowSQL client. missing for 10: evidence of agent-friendly specifics (machine-readable output, non-interactive/scriptable auth, AI-workflow integration), independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
